name: pearl-vscode
description: Chat, autonomous execution, patch-preview approval, and repository-aware assistance from Pearl, a self-hostable AI coding agent.

pearl.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used to run Pearl's MCP server (`<pythonPath> -m src.mcp`). Point this at the interpreter inside the Pearl repo's virtual environment if 'python3' does not have Pearl's dependencies installed.

pearl.provider.description: Informational only: the LLM provider Pearl's MCP server is configured to use (e.g. claude, openai, ollama, custom), shown in the status bar. This mirrors your server-side PEARL_LLM_PROVIDER setting but is not read from the server itself — set it to match if you want it displayed.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npx vsce package
